title: Rex Fraction: Voice & Style Guide
creator: not declared; Rex Fraction is the represented voice/subject
description:
An undeclared-author voice-and-style governance guide for producing material in the Rex Fraction register.

The guide distinguishes Rex Fraction’s enterprise voice from Lee Sharks’s theoretical and poetic voice through pragmatic, direct, ROI-oriented, professional language; short declarative sentences; problem–cost–solution structure; a bounded operational lexicon; and platform-specific formats. It prescribes white-paper, blog, case-study, email, and LinkedIn structures and lists red flags intended to prevent the two registers from collapsing. This is a production manual for a represented authorial voice, not evidence that Rex Fraction independently authored the guide or that all later Rex Fraction works obey the early January 2026 restrictions.
